PR #4745 fixed the GetThreadGroupSize half of #4619 and closes
nothing. A repo-wide search for the accessor the reporter named
returns exactly two things -- this issue and that PR -- with no
edge between them. So the issue's own timeline shows no fix: it was
labelled `enhancement` + `reflection` in 2024-01 and milestoned to
Backlog in 2024-09, both well after the fix had shipped, and it
still has zero comments.

The second half -- output topology on the reflection API -- is not
fixed, and the release matrix shows it never was. That half really
is an open enhancement.
